fun {M} [FirstOrder.Language.Structure.{0, 0, 0} SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M] {X} P a t =>
  And (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV t)
    (Not
      (Exists.{1} fun l =>
        Exists.{1} fun u =>
          And (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV l)
            (And (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV u)
              (And (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeLt l t)
                (And (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeLt t u)
                  (∀ (v : M),
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV v →
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeLt l v →
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.EndpointLogic.codeLt v u →
                          Iff (P a v) (P a t)))))))
def DiamondIntegral.Section3.completedKernelQuotientEquiv.{u, v} : {R : Type u} →
  {T : Type v} →

def DiamondIntegral.Section3.completionDirectSumEquiv.{u, v} : {I : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq.{u + 1} I] →
    (A : I → Type v) →
      [inst : (i : I) → AddCommMonoid.{v} (A i)] →
        AddEquiv.{max v u, max v u} (Algebra.GrothendieckAddGroup.{max v u} (DirectSum.{u, v} I A))

def DiamondIntegral.Section3.ringCompletionCongr.{u, v} : {R : Type u} →

      [inst_1 : CommSemiring.{v} T] →
        RingEquiv.{u, v} R T →
          RingEquiv.{u, v} (DiamondIntegral.Section3.RingCompletion.{u} R)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section3.RingCompletion.{v} T) :=

    Algebra.GrothendieckAddGroup.liftRingHom.{v, u}
      (RingHom.comp.{v, u, u} Algebra.GrothendieckAddGroup.ofRingHom.{u}
        (RingEquiv.toRingHom.{v, u} (RingEquiv.symm.{u, v} e)));
  have hBF := ⋯;
  have hFB := ⋯;
  RingEquiv.ofRingHom.{u, v} F B hFB hBF

  Equiv.mk.{max (max (max (u + 1) (v + 1)) (w + 1)) (x + 1), max (max (max (u + 1) (v + 1)) (w + 1)) (x + 1)}

      Prod.mk.{max u w, max v x} (Sigma.mk.{u, w} (Sigma.fst.{max u v, max w x} p).1 (Sigma.snd.{max u v, max w x} p).1)
        (Sigma.mk.{v, x} (Sigma.fst.{max u v, max w x} p).2 (Sigma.snd.{max u v, max w x} p).2))
    (fun p =>
      Sigma.mk.{max u v, max w x} (Prod.mk.{u, v} (Sigma.fst.{u, w} p.1) (Sigma.fst.{v, x} p.2))
